items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I met my young lady here, Evelyn... he'd invited Evelyn and I to his home

ctx.x: No. A trumpet player. Anyway he came by, he says 'Hot doggit, it you know who I just saw? Hawk out there on Broadway, looked just like Jesus.' Well I hadn't seen Hawk. See, and then, Evelyn hadn't seen Hawk really perform, see, because I been knowing Hawk way back there before I even started, you see I knew Hawk way before he knew me. And Hawk always used to dress immaculate and keep that horn immaculate, man, just as clean, at the time. There was a store there, Laytons and Phil Kronfield, where you used to go…
Well he was drinking himself to death.
